'''Silvia''' — online as '''@ailaughatmyownjokes''' — is a sketch-comedy and roleplay creator from '''South Tyrol''', the German-speaking Alpine region of northern Italy, which is why her work slides between Italian and German. She built an enormous following on TikTok and YouTube (several million followers, and she is managed by the German influencer agency INSTINCT3), and the self-deprecating handle — "I laugh at my own jokes" — sets the tone: the comedy is loose, in-character, and often gleefully "funny-mean" — edgy, deadpan, and happy to roast. She appears in [[Media and Personalities]] as a '''YouTuber entry''', covered for what she actually makes. What sets her apart is pure performing '''range''': she plays every character herself — a one-woman cast. It is the same feat audiences praise in an actor who carries a whole film by becoming everyone in it, the Peter Sellers / Eddie Murphy / Tatiana Maslany kind of talent, done at internet speed and volume.

== The Silviaverse ==

Her signature is the '''"Silviaverse"''' — a sprawling, interconnected cast of her own invented '''original characters''', all played by Silvia, built up across recurring series rather than borrowed from existing franchises. She does the voices, the costumes, the bits, and the running continuity; the humor is offbeat, meme-forward, and tips into '''creepypasta / internet-horror-adjacent''' territory — strange, slightly unsettling, and very online rather than straight stand-up.

The flagship is '''Villain Silvia''', the star of the '''"If I were a villain"''' series: a gleeful super-villainess with an eye-patch who swears constantly and delights in committing crimes and doing evil — waited on by her devoted assistant '''Marcus''', a caretaker who quietly does everything for her and handles what she doesn't even realize she needs, while she, certain she already knows it all (and usually she does — though not always), chastises him for his trouble. Her register is flat, unbothered menace: a cheerful antihero who mostly just wants your money, shrugs off the collateral damage ("Anyways, I ate the interviewer — I'm sorry, I was hungry"), and keeps marveling that nobody ever stops her. Around her Silvia keeps a roster of other recurring originals that populate the same universe, so returning viewers follow characters and callbacks, not one-off gags. The universe even folds in its own behind-the-scenes: "A Day at the Silvia HQ"–style videos, featuring the character '''Lucia''', turn the making of the videos into part of the story — a mock-documentary tour of the "HQ" where it all gets produced, the same meta instinct that gives Villain Silvia her own top-secret lair. Recurring faces like '''Vicky''' round out the cast.

Much of the Silviaverse runs on recurring '''scenario series''' — the characters dropped into a setting and let loose: a '''bed and breakfast''', an '''escape room''', a '''haunted house''', a '''boat''', and more — alongside the '''"Jack and His Unnamed Girlfriend"''' series. There is also a thread of '''contest''' bits, from a '''cake contest''' to '''cooking''' challenges to '''sandcastle-making''' — the same characters pitted against each other in some new competition. The haunted-house entries, for instance, pair her with Vicky for Italian-language reaction comedy (billed as ''Casa Infestata''); most of these scenario and contest series live on her TikTok rather than the YouTube Shorts feed. It is this mix of persistent characters and repeatable formats that lets the universe keep generating episodes without ever running dry.

== Fandom roleplay ==

Alongside the Silviaverse she is also a prolific '''fandom roleplay''' creator: short in-character sketches that imagine what a character would be like in a given setting, performed largely by herself. '''Harry Potter''' is her most-featured universe, with '''The Walking Dead''', '''Scream''', '''The Hunger Games''', '''Twilight''', '''The Vampire Diaries''', '''Pretty Little Liars''', ''Annabelle'' and even ''iCarly'' turning up besides. Many of the best-loved ones are two-handers with '''@redheadbegins''' set in the Potter world — the running "R.I.P. Hermy" and Dobby bits, the Mirror of Erised gag — and she brings in collaborators such as the VFX artist '''@nost___''' for the bigger effects. It is the same one-person-does-every-role craft turned onto worlds the audience already loves.

== Collaborations and reach ==

She frequently collaborates with her roommate '''@redheadbegins''', who makes similar videos, and the two run joint bits — including a recurring series, ''OnlyCakes''. Her reach runs to several million followers across platforms, and her videos circulate even further through reaction and compilation uploads by other creators — a sign of how recognizable her characters have become.

== Why she fits the Library ==

A performer with the '''range''' to build and voice an entire fictional universe single-handed — every character, with continuity and lore, and the same craft extended into the worlds fans already know — is the kind of talent the great multi-role actors are celebrated for, here turned into a one-woman studio. It also rhymes with ideas the Library takes seriously: the [[Egregore]] notion of a single self that holds many personae, and the internet-native, slightly-haunted storytelling the section tracks elsewhere ([[Sarah Davis Baker]]). We note her as a standout example of the form.
